description: Kept the notched stick beside the chalk, and closed the correcting of John.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Said the pair had been eightpence, and forbade the correction at dinner.
name: Mary Shakespeare

description: Cast the columns, and kept the grandfather's penny on the slate rather than at the table.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Taught the dozen into shillings, and called the fourpence an example.
name: William Shakespeare
